fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-08-16, the complainant noticed that Rs. 4,50,000 had been withdrawn through multiple online transactions in a short interval. The time of the incident was given as 14:30 on 2025-08-10. Siva Velan approached Chennai North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000435. Kishore Babu (mobile 9000000076) was named as a possible person of interest. A witness, Padmini Raj, reachable on 9000000032, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents and digital documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00077, as the mobile number 9000000076 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
